name: Integer AX Octa Joint bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed BB-SL32 Octa Joint bottom-bracket parts, 325 g, separately from the FC-AX21 chainwheel/protector figures. The weighed spindle/shell variant is not selected. This is not a square-taper assembly and is not asserted to be BB-AX31.

sources.title: Shimano Bicycle System Components, 1982, PDF page 87 / printed page 84: BB-SL32 identity, configuration and listed specifications
